in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows light and prosperity

in_hindi.name: दीपाश्री
in_hindi.meaning: दीप - दीपा (light), अश्री - अश्रिया (prosperity, happiness, or wealth)

in_tamil.name: தீபாச்சிரி
in_tamil.meaning: தீபம் - திருவளர் (light), அச்சிரி - அருவியல் (prosperity, happiness, or wealth)

in_telugu.name: దీపాశ్రీ
in_telugu.meaning: దీపము - దీపాలు (light), అశ్రీ - అశ్రీణము (prosperity, happiness, or wealth)
in_telugu.long_meaning: దీపాశ్రీ - జ్యోతిశ్మతీ (goddess of light), దేశికేశ్వరి (goddess of wealth)

in_marathi.name: Deepashri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepashri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepa (light) + Ashri (knowledge or wisdom). This name signifies the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. The divine goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, is often depicted holding a lamp (Deepa) in her hand. Hence, Deepashri is a name that evokes the goddess's blessings.

in_bengali.name: Deepashri

in_bengali.long_meaning: Deepashri একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Deepa (light) + Ashri (knowledge or wisdom). This name signifies the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. The divine goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, is often depicted holding a lamp (Deepa) in her hand. Hence, Deepashri is a name that evokes the goddess's blessings.
